item.title: Sixteen - John Martyn

item.title: 17 - John Martyn
item.description: Seventeen years ago today (29 January 2009) John passed away. Charismatic and uncompromising, John’s music was always evolving, inspiring and heartfelt. John was one of a kind. Our thoughts and hearts are with John’s family and loved ones. Celebrate John’s life by playing your favourite album.
